title: SewerOverflowModelResult, profile B (DRAFT 0.1, not decided)
description: DRAFT. A temporary model made for the PoC. Not decided. Not agreed with the data owner, the provider or the City's technical custodian. Not submitted to Smart Data Models. Not proposed as a general model. A modelled result for one sewer overflow chamber and one modelled day: inflow, overflow, level, the period, where the values come from and under which agreement they were delivered. Key-value form (the simplified NGSI-LD form).

inflowMeanM3S.description: Mean inflow rate to the chamber over the modelled day. Unit: cubic metre per second (MQS).

inflowPeakM3S.description: Highest modelled inflow rate to the chamber during the modelled day. Unit: cubic metre per second (MQS).

inflowVolumeM3.description: Total volume that flowed into the chamber during the modelled day (sum of inflow rate times time step). Unit: cubic metre (MTQ).

overflowVolumeM3.description: Total volume that overflowed from the chamber during the modelled day. Unit: cubic metre (MTQ).

overflowPeakM3S.description: Highest modelled overflow rate during the modelled day. Unit: cubic metre per second (MQS).

overflowDurationMin.description: Total time within the modelled day during which the modelled overflow rate was above zero (a sum, not the longest single episode). Unit: minute (MIN).

waterLevelMaxM.description: Highest modelled water level in the chamber during the modelled day. The height reference is not specified in the source data. Unit: metre (MTR).

modelledDay.description: The calendar day (UTC) the result is modelled for.

periodStart.description: Start of the modelled period (ISO 8601, UTC).

periodEnd.description: End of the modelled period (ISO 8601, UTC). Also used as the observedAt time of the values.

dataSource.description: Where the values come from: measured (a full day of measurements), measured-partial (part of the day) or modelled-synthetic (a synthetic series, not data).

modelVersion.description: Name and version of the calculation model that produced the values.

overflowStart.description: Start of the first time step with overflow in the modelled day. Absent when there was no overflow.

overflowEnd.description: End of the last time step with overflow in the modelled day. Absent when there was no overflow. Overflow need not be continuous between start and end.

measuredCoverage.description: Share (0 to 1) of the day's time steps that rest on measured values. Only for chambers with a sensor.

syntheticScale.description: Scale factor applied to a measured pattern to make a synthetic inflow series. Present only when dataSource is modelled-synthetic. PoC specific.

syntheticOverflowScale.description: Scale factor applied to make a synthetic overflow series. Present only when dataSource is modelled-synthetic. PoC specific.

sampleCount.description: Number of time steps the day's aggregates are computed from.

refWeir.description: The chamber this result belongs to (identifier of a SewerOverflowWeir entity).

contractAgreementId.description: Identifier of the contract agreement under which the data was delivered (provider side).

contractAgreementUrl.description: Address of the agreement in the City's agreement register.

distribution.description: Distribution of the data product: A (full) or B (open).

distributionId.description: Identifier of the distribution in the catalogue.

producedAt.description: Time the values were produced (ISO 8601, UTC).

ingestedAt.description: Time the City's platform received the delivery (ISO 8601, UTC).

accessRights.description: Whether the distribution is public or non-public.

informationClass.description: The information class of the distribution (for example K0R1T1 or K1R1T1).

license.description: The licence or agreement terms the distribution is offered under.

publisher.description: The organisation that produced and published the data.

receivedVia.description: How the data reached the City's platform.

transferProcessId.description: Identifier of the transfer in the data space connector.

provenance.description: Where the delivery came from and under which agreement.

weirId.description: The data owner's key for the chamber. The same key follows the chamber through the whole chain and ends the entity identifier.

regionId.description: Identifier of the region (area) the chamber belongs to in the source register.

category.description: Classification of the chamber in the source register.

weirType.description: Type of chamber or weir structure in the source register.

seriesRef.description: Reference to the sensor series of the chamber in the source system, when there is one.

outlet.description: The discharge point (outlet) the chamber overflows to.

recipient.description: The receiving water body (recipient) of the discharge point.

source.description: Where the chamber's record comes from: the name of the data owner's register file it was read from.

dataProvider.description: The party that supplied the chamber's record to the data space (the provider).

description.description: A free-text description of the chamber from the data owner's register.

SewerOverflowWeir.description: A sewer overflow chamber (brunn) as recorded in the data owner's register.
